svg.desc: Trace Bloom section banner for Meta on lifehacker.dev. How lifehacker.dev is built and how the autopilot that runs it works. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Fallback cover for docs pages that carry no banner of their own. Seed 3892331084.
